glossary.definition: Dataflow Engine - the OTAP-native Rust pipeline being benchmarked in this repo.
OpenTelemetry Collector (contrib distribution) - the reference Go implementation.
Fluent Bit - An observability pipeline engine in the fluentd family.
OpenTelemetry Arrow Protocol - columnar gRPC transport using Apache Arrow record batches.
OpenTelemetry Protocol - the standard row-oriented gRPC/HTTP protobuf protocol.
Kafka-based transport using OTLP protobuf message encoding (producer -> broker -> consumer pipeline).
Kafka-based transport using OTAP Arrow protobuf message encoding (producer -> broker -> consumer pipeline).
Benchmark that measures only a variant's Kafka receiver. A fixed DFE Kafka exporter produces to the broker; the benchmarked receiver consumes and forwards to a DFE backend.
Benchmark that measures only a variant's Kafka exporter. A DFE loadgen feeds the benchmarked exporter, which produces to the broker; a fixed DFE Kafka receiver consumes on the backend.

suites.description: Measures resource efficiency while a single-core DFE applies an attribute rename to a fixed offered load of 100K logs/sec across OTLP and OTAP input/output combinations. The load generator and sink each run on a separate core.
suites.name: Attribute Processor Protocol Routing

suites.description: Measures the resource-efficiency impact of receiver acknowledgment-based flow control at a fixed offered load of 100K logs/sec. A single-core DFE applies an attribute rename with wait-for-result enabled, then exports to a separate one-core backend DFE ending in an in-memory performance sink. The backend receiver acknowledges accepted data quickly without waiting for the sink, so it is not deliberately throttled.
suites.name: Backpressure
